name: Remove News
summary: Uninstall News for your account.
what: Removes the Microsoft.BingNews package for the current account. Other accounts are not touched.
benefit: Less clutter in Start and search, and no background updates for the app.
risk: Low. The app can be put back with Revert or from the Microsoft Store.
advice: Suggested unless you read news in this app.
facts: A news reader app that is separate from the taskbar and Widgets feeds
Removes it for your account only
Revert restores it if Windows still has the files, otherwise reinstall from the Microsoft Store
